is_auto.description:
Set to true if this message is sent automatically (e.g. by your own bot/script),
not by a person who has actually read the buyer's previous messages.
When true, the buyer's earlier messages in this chat are NOT marked as read for the seller,
so the "unread" indicator is preserved until a real person reviews the conversation.
Default: false (behaves as before - the chat is marked as read, as with a normal reply).
